user.title: Energy Price Comparison
user.description: Compare the same grid-import consumption using configured net energy rates and historical PSE RCE prices. Totals exclude VAT, distribution and supplier fees. Use a cumulative energy meter. Times are HH:MM in Home Assistant's time zone; G12/G12w summer hours follow DST. G12w weekends and G12n Sundays use the night rate; public holidays are not separately modelled. Saving options recalculates all periods using the new rates.

abort.already_configured: Energy Price Comparison is already set up. Use the configure button (⚙️) to change configuration.

error.invalid_rate: Enter a finite, non-negative net rate in PLN/kWh.
error.invalid_time: Enter a valid time as HH:MM.
error.invalid_energy_source: Choose a cumulative energy sensor (Wh, kWh or MWh) with total or total_increasing state class.
error.invalid_ranges: Day/night boundaries must be in chronological order and must not be equal.
